artifacts.title: Six-month PCA membership requirement for ministerial candidacy from non-PCA church
artifacts.disposition: advice given — BCO 18-2 probably requires PCA membership; overture recommended

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that BCO 18-2 probably requires PCA congregation membership for candidacy, but acknowledged varying presbytery practice and recommended an overture to clarify whether endorsement from a non-PCA ruling body is permissible.

artifacts.title: Scope of the extraordinary clause for ordination candidates

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that under BCO 18-2 the extraordinary clause excuses only the six-month membership period, not the session endorsement, the two-month filing deadline, or the one-year internship sequence.

artifacts.title: Prohibition of dual candidacy under BCO 18-7

matches.evidence: BCO 18-7 permits a candidate to retain home-church membership while under another presbytery's care, but does not allow simultaneous candidacy under two presbyteries.

artifacts.title: Flexibility for candidates applying to come under presbytery care

matches.evidence: The CCB found the proposed amendment to BCO 18-2 allowing flexible application procedures for candidates not in conflict with the Constitution.

artifacts.disposition: Approved → sent to presbyteries; ratification not located
